info.description: AgentNet is a centralized Agent Relay Platform for registering agents, routing asynchronous tasks, tracking delivery state, and enforcing cross-agent approval policy. WebSocket agent transport is available at `/v1/ws` and documented in `docs/openapi.md`.
info.title: AgentNet API

get.description: Return a lightweight liveness response without requiring authentication.
List the authenticated user's agents with pagination, status filtering, and search.

post.description: Register a new agent owned by the authenticated user. The response includes the one-time raw agent token used for WebSocket connections.

delete.description: Delete an agent owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Return one agent owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Revoke the existing active token for an agent and issue a replacement. The raw replacement token is shown only in this response.

get.description: List human-in-the-loop approval requests owned by the authenticated user's agents.

post.description: Accept a pending approval request after verifying target agent ownership.
Reject a pending approval request after verifying target agent ownership.

get.description: List API keys owned by the authenticated user. Raw key material is never returned.

post.description: Issue a new API key for the authenticated user. The raw key is returned only once.
Revoke an API key owned by the authenticated user. By default the API refuses to revoke the user's final active key to avoid accidental lockout.
Create the user if it does not exist and return a newly issued API key. The raw API key is shown only in this response.
post.summary: Register or fetch a user and issue an API key

get.description: List connection records for the authenticated user's first agent.

post.description: Create a pending connection request from the user's first agent to a target Agent Number.
Accept a pending connection request after verifying target agent ownership.
Reject a pending connection request after verifying target agent ownership.

get.description: List tasks visible to the authenticated user with optional status filtering.

post.description: Create an asynchronous task from one owned sender agent to a target Agent Number. Delivery is routed online immediately or stored for offline delivery.

get.description: Return a task owned by or assigned to an agent owned by the authenticated user.
Return persisted messages for a task after verifying user ownership.
Return historical progress entries for a task after verifying user ownership.
